<a id="program_entry"></a>
### [`program_entry`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L6) `$1158`

*label*

Program entry from the loader. It jumps to the cold start at $1601.

<a id="move_return_flags"></a>
### [`move_return_flags`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L9) `$115B-$1173`

*data*

Move table, one byte per move $00-$18. Bit 7 keeps the input of the move; nonzero lets the move return to the stance by itself.

- **Read by:** [`move_update_state`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_update_state) [`$2362`](../../../../src/fighter/fighter_moves.asm#L182), [`move_anim_end`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_anim_end) [`$23BF`](../../../../src/fighter/fighter_moves.asm#L246)
